content.text: When working through a test case, I've discovered the code as-is will accept either acl:Agent foaf:Agent or acl:AgentClass foaf:Agent.  I'm assuming we want just acl:AgentClass here and not acl:Agent at all?

Also noticed that enabling webac requires AuthN.  So iin this case, we consider "Public" viewing to be any authenticated user?  Just want to clarify scope and make sure I'm not on the hook for 'anonymous' browsing where no credentials are provided.

It's probably necessary to allow anonymous reads somehow (without credentials of any sort), where permitted by ACLs.  Maybe via choice of principal provider (i.e. provide a default URI to designate anonymous users, when no user principal has been provided by any means of authn?)
, yes, we should only support
acl:AgentClass
As for anonymous access, this is the situation that

resolved with Tomcat Values. The fact is that in default configurations, requests will be prompted for AuthN before they even get to Fedora. In the context of this ticket, "allowing any authenticated user" to access resources protected by "acl:AgentClass foaf:Agent" is sufficient.

I would suggest a follow-on ticket for allowing true open access of certain resources even when WebAC is enabled. It is not clear to me that that particular challenge is one that can be resolved exclusively at the Fedora level.

, I concur that this is something that we won't be able to solve exclusively at the Fedora level, as long as we are relying on the servlet container to provide AuthN. As you say, at UMD we had to implement a set of valves [1] to parse out preemptive authentication information from the HTTP requests and add them as security principals to the servlet request. Plus, we had to create a separate micro-webapp [2] that just prompts for AuthN and puts the credentials into a shared session.
https://github.com/umd-lib/optional-authn-valve
https://github.com/umd-lib/fcrepo-user-webapp
Created issue for exploring anonymous access:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2637
I know you've been busy, just wondering if this is close or if you need someone to help take it over?
Yes, I've dropped the ball on this one and don't see myself getting much free time in the near future.  If someone else wants to take the initiative on this, that'd be great.
Do you have any work in progress that might help the next worker?
I have implemented this with PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1321
Closed PR #1321. New PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1334
Resolved with
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/0843f67a8cab8ec691553be7502194482ae6ca08
The modeshape impl: uses 'acl:agent foaf:Agent' to denote public access, but the spec defines 'acl:agentClass foaf:Agent'.
